title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg is hiding the baby dragon? Watch to find out! 🐉🔥 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Kidify #FunForKids #BrainTeaser #EggReveal

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a baby dragon — but which one?
We've got a blue egg, a red egg, and a golden egg. Pick your favorite — fast!
Three… two… one — let's find out!
The blue egg cracks open and — oh! It's just a rubber duck. Quack!
The red egg pops open and… a tiny sock falls out. Not the dragon!
The golden egg glows, shakes, and — BOOM — out comes the baby dragon! You found it!
Nice job! The golden egg wins! Come back tomorrow for Level 2 — it's way harder!
